faq.q: What kind of photos should I send?
faq.a: 3–5 photos of the space from different angles, plus close-ups of anything specific (damage, or anything you want replaced). Phone photos are perfect.
We serve homeowners in Illinois and Indiana. If you're not sure we cover your area, submit a request and we'll let you know.

faq.q: Will you post photos of my home?
faq.a: Never the photos you send us. Those are only for planning your project. Once a job is finished, Jorge may photograph the completed work for our website and Facebook, without your address, name, or faces. Prefer not? Just tell Jorge.

faq.q: How quickly will I hear back?
faq.a: Requests are reviewed within 1–3 business days. You'll get a text or email with next steps.

policies.title: Privacy, Terms & Accessibility
policies.draft: Draft outline. Final wording to be reviewed by an attorney before launch.

sections.p: Your name, phone, email, project address, project details, and any photos you upload.
Only to review, estimate, schedule, and complete your project, and to contact you about it. We do not sell your information or use your photos for marketing.

Service providers that run this website, acting on our behalf: hosting & database, email/text delivery, an address-lookup service (OpenStreetMap's Photon) that suggests addresses as you type, and an AI service that helps summarize and translate project details (it does not receive your name or contact details).

Photos you upload with your request are only used to review and plan your project. They are never posted, sold, or used for marketing. After a project is finished, Jorge may take his own photos of the completed work and share them on our website and social media (like Facebook). We never show your address, name, or anyone's face. If you'd rather we don't feature your project, just tell Jorge.

Text messages are how we handle your request and project: scheduling, updates, and payment reminders. We never send marketing texts. Reply STOP at any time, and we'll stop texting and use email or phone instead. Your project and payment schedule don't change.
Requests that don't become projects are deleted after 12–24 months [to be confirmed]. Contact us to request a copy or deletion of your information at any time.
Price ranges shared before a site visit are estimates only, not a binding quote. Your final price is in a written quote/contract after the visit.
We want this site to work for everyone and aim to meet WCAG 2.2 AA. If anything is hard to use, contact us and we'll help.
